verses.english: In both ways consummate, I’m known as Rāhula the Fortunate: because I’m the son of the Buddha, because I’ve the eye that sees Dhammas, because my effluents are ended, because I’ve no further becoming. I’m deserving of offerings, a worthy one a three-knowledge man, one with sight of the deathless. Those blinded by sensuality covered by the net, veiled by the veil of craving, bound by the Kinsman of the heedless, are like fish in the mouth of a trap. Throwing that sensuality aside, cutting through Māra’s bond, pulling out craving, root & all, cooled am I. Unbound.
